items.title: Costco's Generator Sellouts Prompt a New Wall Street Stock Call
items.summary: Shoppers stock up on essentials following major technology outages, driving demand for generators, food and emergency supplies.

items.title: McDonald’s vs Yum Brands: value and income versus growth and momentum
items.summary: Investing.com -- McDonald’s Corporation (MCD) offers the stronger quality-and-income profile; Yum! Brands Inc (YUM) offers faster growth and stronger momentum. The valuation gap is now surprisingly narrow.
